title: Bara Bara no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + Chop-Chop Festival as the peak (no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance (One Piece Wiki): an oval purple fruit (orange in the anime) made of little spherical pieces with swirls and green leaves on top
Paramecia, Chop-Chop Fruit: the user can split the body into pieces and control them
Immune to slashing: blades just separate him (Chop-Chop Cannon shoots his hand; Emergency Escape pops off his head)
Chop-Chop Festival: splits into many tiny pieces
His feet cannot float and must stay on the ground
Buggy swallowed it by accident on Roger's ship (Oro Jackson)

plan.labels: NO CUTS, CANNON, HEAD POP, FESTIVAL
plan.fruit: One Piece Wiki Appearance: **an oval purple fruit made of little spherical pieces with swirls and green leaves on top** (purple as in the manga; the script says purple).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a ronin swordsman with a straw kasa hat and a topknot.
**Buggy:** big red round nose, blue hair, red lips and grin, black tricorn hat, red captain coat. Send a reference to match him exactly.
plan.sets: carnival at night, amber rays, market fruit stall, magician's stage, jigsaw-piece wall, Japanese garden, shooting gallery, haunted hallway, confetti arena, muddy field with footprints, army obstacle course, legendary old ship at night, bathroom.
